My name is Ashwathy. I’m from Thevara. It was on October 2, 2021, that I took the covenant. At that time, it was during the COVID period, so this church wasn’t open.
So my husband and I used to come every day and pray in front of this church. One day when we came, the church happened
to be open. So we went inside. At that time, they used to let people in only if their names were written in the front.
When we entered, the brother sitting there asked us, “Are you planning to go to the UK?”
Until then, we hadn’t even thought about it. But we did have a wish to go abroad someday. So, when we wrote our intentions in our covenant, we wrote that we wanted to go to the UK.
We didn’t know how it would happen, but we wrote it as one of our intentions in the covenant. Then we went back home. As per the covenant, our life continued to move forward.
Through an agency, I got an interview with a company. Things were moving forward, but that company and the agency suddenly shut down.
We faced some financial loss. When we came here again, they said it wouldn’t be possible to meet Father. So I looked
at the statue of the Holy Mother and prayed, saying, “If only I could see Father and get a message.”
When the manager asked Father, he said, “Let her come in.” So I took a token and met Father. After meeting him, Father said, “You will get your money back.”
At that time, I had my passport in my hand. I told him, “I don’t want to go anywhere now. I just want my money back.” Then I received Father’s blessing, and as I was about to leave,
Father took my passport, touched it to the statue of Mother Mary, and handed it back to me.
Father asked me, “Are you satisfied just getting your money back? Don’t you want to reach where you had wished to go?”
I looked at Father with tears in my eyes because I didn’t know what to say. Then Father said to me, “Wherever you wished to go, the Holy Mother will take you there.”
After that, we went back and continued keeping the covenant faithfully. My husband and I started distributing the Kreupasanam newspaper
everywhere — in Ernakulam Hospital, Thrippunithura Hospital, Perumbavoor, Thodupuzha — we used to go by bike and give it to people.
My husband even bought Tamil newspapers and took them to Coimbatore to distribute.
We used to pack food and give it to people too. Whoever came to us asking for help, we never turned them away. While continuing in the covenant like this, within just one month of meeting Father,
I got an interview call. I had studied in Malayalam medium, so I was really scared about attending the interview.
I held tightly in my hand the covenant locket of Mother and sprinkled blessed salt all over the system, applied holy oil, and made the sign of the cross on the system before sitting for the interview.
During the interview, I didn’t even know exactly what I was answering. Because first of all, I couldn’t fully understand what they were
saying. It was the first time I was attending an interview in English — before this, I had only worked here in Kerala.
I kept anointing the system with holy oil from time to time and kept making the sign of the cross.
After the interview, they asked me, “Do you want to know the result?” They had asked me 25 questions.
Smiling, they lifted the paper and said to me, “You have answered 24 questions correctly. You are selected.”
Within just one month, I received sponsorship and got my visa. I attended the interview in November, and by December itself, I reached the UK. I joined a very good company that supported me a lot.
It was truly by the blessing of the Holy Mother. The three of us reached there through her grace, and even there, we continued faithfully in the covenant.
From that time onward, we never turned back. We used only the covenant materials for everything. It has now been three years, and in all those three years, we never even took a single GP appointment.
Whatever sickness or problem came, only the Holy Mother’s salt, oil, and honey healed us. Whenever anyone came from here
on leave and asked me, “What do you want from Kerala?” I would say, “Just bring me the Kreupasanam paper.”
I love giving the paper to others because there, most of the people are non-Catholics. When I meet Pentecostal believers, I go and read the paper aloud to them.
When I read it out, I know they’ll then ask me for a copy of the paper. That’s why I read it
to them. For some, I would even take an appointment and say, “I’ll bring the paper to this place on this day.”
In this way, I continued faithfully in the covenant. As my visa period was coming to an end, some
problems started in the company. Our salary got delayed, and I couldn’t understand what was really happening inside the company.
They weren’t saying anything about my visa extension
Only 20 days were left. Every day, I attended Father’s Daily Bread prayer. One day while attending it, I prayed,
“Holy Mother, I have only the covenant before me. I have 20 days left. I don’t know what to do.
The people in my company aren’t telling me anything — neither that they’ll renew it nor that they won’t. But I have only the covenant before me.”
At that very second, Father, during the prayer, said aloud, “Holy Mother, there are those who have only the covenant before them, praying for visa extensions. Mother is now making her decision regarding them.”
Hearing that, I felt peace. Every morning while going to work, I carried the Kreupasanam paper with me. During my short breaks, I would walk around and distribute the papers.
I would also read it to people, because if I simply handed it to them, they wouldn’t take it. But when I read it aloud, they became interested.
Then they would surely accept it from me. So I kept reading it to them. At that time, only 20
days were left in my company contract. One evening, my manager called me and said, “Come to the office this evening.”
I carried the blessed salt and oil with me because I didn’t know what they were going to say. If they said they wouldn’t renew my visa, I would have no option left.
Because even if it were 20 months instead of 20 days, finding a new sponsorship there would not be possible. So I didn’t know what they were going to tell me in those 20 days.
Because at that time there were some issues within the company — a few compliance matters had gone to the authorities.
So I took the blessed salt with me and went. When I reached there, my registered manager was sitting and
looking at the computer. Without them noticing, I quietly took some salt and sprinkled it over the buttons of that system.
I kept praying while tightly holding the blessed oil in my hand. The locket I received when I took the covenant — I’ve never removed it from my neck since then. I held it tightly too.
Then the manager looked at me, smiled, and said, “Can you wait for half an hour? We’ll give you your sponsorship right now.”
That’s how I received my sponsorship. I applied for my visa afterward. But since the rules had changed by then, everyone said there was little chance for it to be successful.
My visa was set to expire on October 25. I had told the Holy Mother, “Mother, whatever happens, I must come for your rally. Even if I
don’t get my visa, I will still come — because a covenant doesn’t mean just getting a visa; living in the covenant itself is a great blessing.”
“But Mother, please, when I walk in your rally, let me walk with joy.” That’s what I prayed. I applied for my
visa and fixed a date in faith: October 14 — “Mother, let the visa come by October 14 for all three of us.”
Everyone told me, “Maybe only your visa will get approved; the dependents might get rejected.” But I remained firm in my faith and continued forward in the covenant.
On the evening before that date, I told my husband, “Tomorrow is October 14 — the date I set.” He looked at me with concern because only one night was left.
The next morning, when I stepped out, I took the Kreupasanam paper with me. Whenever I go out with
the paper, I feel great courage — because when I distribute it, I feel the Holy Mother is with me.
Talking about Mother to someone gives me deep peace and satisfaction.
That day too, I went out with the paper in hand. Around 11 a.m. on October 14, while I was
listening to Mother’s prayer on my mobile, a notification popped up — an email message saying, “Your visa is successful.”
Everyone had said it would only be for one year, but I received it successfully for three years. At that moment, I called my manager—
I called and told my manager that my visa was successful. She said over the phone, “All credits go to your Kreupasanam Mother,”
They are Pentecostals, but still I say, “It is the Holy Mother who keeps me strong.” When I checked, I saw that my
husband, my daughter, and I — all three of us — received our visas successfully for three years, without any obstacles or accidents.
I didn’t have to spend even a single rupee. The company bore all the expenses. I thank the Holy Mother immensely for blessing us so abundantly.
Later, my husband had severe back pain. We didn’t take any medicine — only used the Holy Mother’s blessed materials. We tried various other methods, but nothing worked.
Finally, we stopped all medicines completely and used only the Holy Mother’s blessed objects — and he was completely healed.
Once he also had a lump in his throat, and a biopsy test was done. Even then, the results came out completely normal — no problems at all. It was only because of the Holy Mother’s blessed materials.
We haven’t taken even a single GP appointment. Even when we had a toothache, we just applied the blessed salt and prayed — and it disappeared instantly at that very moment.
Since 2021, we’ve been living in the covenant. Because of the covenant, we have great courage — the unshakable faith that whatever happens, the Holy Mother is with us.
We have no words to express our gratitude, because we always feel Mother’s presence — we even get the fragrance of jasmine flowers at times.
About two weeks ago, I had a dream — I saw a seashore, and there was a chapel. Outside it stood Father V. P. Joseph.
I went to Father and said, “Mother is inside. After she comes out and after everyone leaves, can you please tell my situation to her?”
Father replied, “I have already told it.” Then Mother came out. She was about six feet tall, wearing a
robe of this color. One of her eyes shone like the surface of the sea, and the other looked normal.
She turned and looked at me — her face gave me a gesture of comfort and peace. Then she walked very fast, holding a rosary in her hand. Behind her were crowds of people walking,
but no one could keep up with her pace — she was walking so swiftly, praying the rosary.
I saw this vision until about 5:30 in the morning. I can’t say it was only a dream, because I
wasn’t fully asleep. I truly felt that Mother had already decided that I would walk joyfully in the Rosary Rally.
I would have attended — even if my visa had not been renewed — because I wanted to participate in the Rosary Rally. On the
14th itself, I booked my ticket. I came only to share my testimony of the Blessed Mother and to take part in this Rosary Rally.
It is the Holy Mother who leads us and takes care of us. To stand on this holy altar, we prepared ourselves through many days of prayer.
After entering into the covenant, when we see someone who has even a little anger, we begin to feel a deep love toward them. I can’t understand how it happens.
I normally don’t get angry, but when I see anyone who is angry, I just feel like going and embracing them. I wonder how the Mother has transformed us in such a way.
It amazes me. In this true covenant, our only prayer is that the Blessed Mother may lead our family throughout our entire lifetime. A thousand thanks to the Holy Mother and to Jesus.
From the Holy Gospel of St. Luke, Chapter 1, verses 49–50: “The Mighty One has done great things for me, and holy is His name. His mercy extends to those who fear Him, from generation to generation.”
What we just heard is Ashwathy’s powerful, love-filled testimony — a manifestation of Jesus’ love.

Here, those who come to pray and those who visit experience the Blessed Mother speaking to them in various ways.
When something happens here — when we feel even the movement of a grain of sand — it feels alive because this is the very place where the Blessed Mother appeared in living form.
To each person, the Holy Mother reveals herself in different ways. Her sacred image seems to emerge, growing ever more radiant. Many have experienced visions, their eyes opening and closing in wonder. These are countless testimonies.
Ashwathy’s testimony is nothing else but the same divine experience — she too felt it.
She says, “Christ is being formed within me.” That is what we come to understand. And now, the covenant — it is not about the visa...

struggle. Whatever may come, she said, “I must go to see the Blessed Mother; I must take part in the Rosary Rally.”
These have become the greatest desires of Ashwathy’s life, because throughout her life she has realized that there is a great Mother who has been walking beside her, guiding her when she lost her way.
She says, “I have received everything from Jesus.” Those who have reached deep spiritual awareness always say, “I need nothing more. I have already

That is what eternity truly means — to be immersed in the love of Jesus.
The daughter says, “When I received my sponsorship and UK visa, I understood — it was not my qualification; it was grace that filled me.”
Father always teaches us that whatever we receive through the prayers offered at our Kreupasanam is not by merit but by grace.
It is through grace that everything becomes possible for us. However great our qualifications may be, it is when we humble ourselves that grace fills us.
This is exactly what when the angel Gabriel greeted her with the words, “Hail, full of grace.”
Through every Holy Mass that Father celebrates for us, he gives the same message — how to receive grace, how to open our hearts to it.
Now, Ashwathy realizes that all the great blessings she has received from the Blessed Mother and from Jesus are indeed graces — gifts freely given, not earned.

These blessings come as we take each step forward in our spiritual life.
Giving thanks to Jesus and the Blessed Mother for all the graces Ashwathy has received, let us close this testimony with a heartfelt applause for Jesus.
